content.intro: This lesson introduces understanding classes and objects as part of python object-oriented programming. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: The key is to connect syntax to the value or behavior it produces. Start with a small expression, predict its result, and then verify it in the interpreter.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A class defines behavior and can be used to create instances with associated state.
